verdicts.reason: This layer-1 account holds Rs 351,532.67 of tainted funds, which is ~84% of the disputed amount, well above the 25% threshold. Although the account appears genuine (10-year-old business, low pass-through, no mule links), the lien only freezes the victim's traced money and the balance (Rs 23.4L) remains largely unaffected.

The tainted share is only 1.37% and the tainted amount (Rs 60,258.37) represents just 14.4% of the disputed sum, meeting neither the ≥50% tainted-share nor the ≥25%-of-disputed threshold.
